full_text: TO THE PEOPLE OF AMERICA. (In  the  following  letter addressed to Americans and mitten  on  August 3, 1942, sometime before the fateful August Disturbances started, Gandhiji asked the in- habitants of America not to be misledby the vilifying pro- paganda of Britain against Indian national leaders including himself. He in due humility called upon them to sift the truth from the chaff and to give moral support to India’s demand for freedom.)
